name: queuescope-tfm
description: Plataforma web per simular càrregues de tasques asíncrones i comparar polítiques de planificació.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @queuescope/contracts && npm run build --workspace @queuescope/simulation-engine && npm run build --workspace @queuescope/api && npm run build --workspace @queuescope/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @queuescope/contracts && npm run build --workspace @queuescope/simulation-engine && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @queuescope/contracts && npm run build --workspace @queuescope/simulation-engine && npm run db:generate --workspace @queuescope/api && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
